status: DESIGN ONLY — no implementation, no live system mutation, no calibration data exists yet
purpose: Score a candidate song's musical parameters against an evidence base of comparable Hindi recordings and return descriptive signals with explicit evidence confidence. It never returns a 'hit probability' until a calibration set with held-out outcomes exists.

key.enum: C, Db, D, Eb, E, F, F#, G, Ab, A, Bb, B

bpm.note: engine stores felt tempo and a half/double flag; both 90 and 180 are checked against the evidence base

energy.note: analyst or analyser estimate; source recorded

vocal_range.note: never inferred; null until measured from a recording of the singer

SUCCESS_SIGNAL_SCORE.rule: null unless the matched evidence cell has n ≥ 30 recordings with outcome data AND a documented calibration run (calibration_id) exists; otherwise the field is null and REASON_NULL explains. Never a probability.

EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE.rule: none: matched cell n < 5; low: 5–29 or single-source key/BPM; medium: ≥30 with ≥2 concordant sources; high: ≥100 with at least one independently measured key/BPM per recording and outcome data with timestamps

REFERENCE_MATCH_SCORE.rule: distance-based similarity to the evidence base on (mode, tempo zone, duration band, emotion, release_type); descriptive only, computable at any n, always accompanied by matched_n

EXPECTED_RETENTION_PROFILE.rule: null until first-party YouTube Analytics retention curves (audience retention export) exist for ≥ 20 own uploads; public views are never converted into retention

examples: absolute key outside singer's measured comfortable range

COMPARABLE_SONGS.type: list of {song_id, title, key, mode, bpm, evidence_ids, outcome_fields_available}
COMPARABLE_SONGS.rule: only recordings present in the frozen dataset with provenance; max 10

evidence_chain_design.description: Every hop is a separate table keyed by its own id and linked to the previous hop; nothing is inferred across a missing hop.

fields: derivative_type (full video, lyrical, short, live, cover-key transposition)

hops.rule: every metric row carries observation_ts and source; views × duration is never stored as watch time

evidence_chain_design.attribution_rule: Attribution shares are recorded with their method and are never summed across methods. A hop with no recorded link returns null downstream, not an estimate.

experiment_design_hooks.experiment_id: one per controlled comparison (e.g., same song, two keys; same chorus, 2 vs 3 repetitions)
experiment_design_hooks.minimum: pre-registered hypothesis text, primary metric, observation window, and the evidence_ids the hypothesis was drawn from
experiment_design_hooks.analysis: descriptive difference with bootstrap CI when n ≥ 20 publications per arm; below that, report raw values only

hit_probability_policy: Disabled by design. A field named HIT_PROBABILITY does not exist in the schema. It may be added only after a calibration run with a held-out set, a Brier score, and a calibration plot are stored under a calibration_id.
mutation_policy: Read-only design. No live system (Make.com, Sheets, YouTube, Spotify) is read or written by this specification.
